bullets.text: Motorway 5G Upgrades - **VMO2** enhances 4G and 5G coverage across 40 major UK motorways, supporting electric vehicle rollout.
Protecting Undersea Networks - UK commits to safeguarding critical undersea networks against rising threats from **Russia** and **China**.
AI Transformation Urgency - **Nokia** warns telecoms face extinction without embracing AI-driven transformations in operations.
Fibre Broadband Growth - UK aims for 99% gigabit-capable broadband by 2032, with over 80% of premises now served.
New Subsea Cable Launch - **Google** introduces TalayLink, enhancing connectivity between **Australia** and **Thailand**.
Spectrum Crunch Warning - **GSMA** highlights urgent need for mid-band spectrum to prevent capacity constraints in urban areas by 2030.
Customer Care Focus - Telecoms must improve customer care strategies to enhance user experience and retention.
Nokia's Job Cuts - **Nokia** plans to close its Munich site, resulting in 700 job losses as part of restructuring.
AI-Ready Networks Investment - **Nokia** announces $4 billion investment in U.S. AI-ready network technologies to enhance connectivity.
